milestone: A60 by-reference Iterator current array spread with key-time outer-cell rebinding
scope: An ordinary no-destructor user Iterator returns a genuine reference to a global-bound ARRAY cell from current(). The raw current cell survives key(), which may rebind it to a different finite row with ordinary scalar reference leaves. Spread dereferences and inserts the new row as DIRECT while a separately saved old row remains distinct. Held and dropped external inner aliases distinguish shared COW from singleton unwrapping. A borrowed Aggregate getter can return the same Iterator. A supplied key throw after external it/row/leaf removal inserts no entry and reaches authentic atomic methodless discard/prune with weak Iterator death before catch.

It rechecks the same live cell after key at insertion. Old raw/KNOWN successes are disjoint; builder, key, generic release, ownership, 427/430 and schema remain unchanged. No owning instance fields/destructor or typed/proxy/object/cyclic/debt descendants are admitted.
